decisive_items: Severe left ventricular systolic dysfunction, ejection fraction 15-20%
Coronary angiography: No significant coronary disease
response.rationale: The clinical picture of dyspnea, edema, elevated BNP, and severe systolic dysfunction with no coronary disease directly supports non-ischemic HFrEF. Tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy is possible but less supported because the documented rhythm is sinus/paroxysmal rather than a sustained tachyarrhythmia. Atrial fibrillation is excluded by the 1:1 P wave-to-QRS relationship.

rejected.why: ECG shows P wave preceding every QRS with 1:1 relationship, which contradicts atrial fibrillation; no irregularly irregular rhythm or absent P waves are described.
